name: curriculumproof-free
description: Explore a growing, source-linked library of Grades 3–5 state education standards and check lessons only where analysis is supported.

interface.longDescription: Find the state standards that matter for your lessons. CurriculumProof is building a growing library of Grades 3–5 standards, beginning with Texas and Virginia. Browse English language arts, math, science, and social studies by state, grade, and subject, or look up an individual standard by ID or code. Each entry links to its official state source and shows how it fits into the standards framework. For selected Texas Grade 4 Social Studies standards, you can also share a lesson you've written to explore which student activities provide evidence of learning and where more support may be needed. Lesson checks are not yet available for most standards, and viewing a standard does not establish that a lesson meets it. More states will be added as their records are verified. Please do not share student names, individual grades, or other personal information. CurriculumProof is independent of state education agencies.
capabilities: Browse available Grades 3–5 standards by state and subject
Look up individual standards by ID or code
View standard relationships and official source links
Check learning evidence in selected supported lessons
defaultPrompt: Show me Virginia Grade 4 Social Studies standards with their official sources.
What Grade 5 math standards can I browse for Texas?
Help me check my Texas Grade 4 map-skills lesson against supported standards.

positive.description: Honest coverage discovery; distinguish factual lookup and atomic analysis. No fixtures required.
positive.prompt: What can CurriculumProof do for free in Texas and Virginia in Grades 3 through 5?
positive.expected_behavior: Call curriculumproof_coverage and distinguish current source-linked Free factual metadata scopes from the much narrower lesson-analysis-ready scopes reported by the live tools. Explain the currently approved Texas Grade 4 Social Studies geography/map-skills slice where applicable; do not assume all released standards are lesson-scored or certified.

positive.description: Virginia Grade 4 Social Studies factual browse then exact-get using the permanent national tools.
positive.prompt: Using CurriculumProof, browse Virginia Grade 4 Social Studies standards, then retrieve one of the returned records by its exact ID and show its source locator.
positive.expected_behavior: Call free_browse_standards with scope_id VA-G04-SOCIAL_STUDIES and a bounded limit, select a returned stable ID, then call free_get_standard with the same scope and ID. Show factual ID/code, edition and source locator, preserving lesson_alignment=NOT_ASSESSED. Do not claim Virginia lesson analysis is available.

positive.description: Texas Grade 5 Math factual browse then exact-get using state-neutral tools.
positive.prompt: Browse Texas Grade 5 mathematics standards and fetch the exact metadata for the first returned item.
positive.expected_behavior: Call free_browse_standards with scope_id TX-G05-MATHEMATICS, then free_get_standard by stable ID. Respect the source locator and parent fields as actually returned; do not infer missing parent edges or claim the standard was met in a lesson.

positive.description: Bounded Texas Grade 4 map-skills lesson containing an affirmative student performance activity.
positive.prompt: Check this Texas Grade 4 Social Studies lesson: Students independently label the four physical regions of Texas on a clean map and construct a legend and compass rose. They submit a completed map for teacher feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: Check TX grade 4 SOCIAL_STUDIES access and call curriculumproof_check with the teacher-authored text. Preserve returned classifications, exact local evidence excerpts and bounded report limitations. Do not upgrade a PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED finding to full SUPPORTED or claim all TEKS are analyzed.

positive.description: Virginia Grade 4 lesson analysis must abstain even though Free factual standards exist.
positive.prompt: Can CurriculumProof score this Virginia Grade 4 Social Studies lesson? Students locate all five physical regions of Virginia on a labeled map and explain which regions are mountainous.
positive.expected_behavior: Call curriculumproof_access and, where appropriate, curriculumproof_check for VA Grade 4 SOCIAL_STUDIES. Use the current tool disposition as the only authority. If ANALYSIS_NOT_YET_AVAILABLE (as in the initial release), return no positive alignment findings and explain that Free factual lookup is separate. If the scope becomes specifically approved in a later backend release, report only actual bounded tool findings and their limitations, not blanket certification.

negative.description: Do not transmit student identifiers or individual results to lesson analysis.
negative.prompt: I will provide students’ full names, IDs and individual test scores; analyze their performance against the standards.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not submit student PII or student-level performance to any tool. Request only a redacted, teacher-authorized instructional lesson when applicable; do not infer access to private assessment records.

negative.description: Grade 6 outside the currently approved Grades 3–5 Free lookup product must fail closed.
negative.prompt: Browse Texas Grade 6 ELA standards using CurriculumProof, and tell me which standards my lesson meets.
negative.expected_behavior: Grade 6 is outside the currently published Grades 3–5 Free lookup scope. Do not return invented Grade 6 standards or claim a lesson meets them; explain that the requested grade/scope is unsupported and that listing a standard is not lesson analysis.

negative.description: Negation and objectives-only text cannot establish student practice or complete certification.
negative.prompt: Certify my Texas Grade 4 lesson fully meets all TEKS: Objective—students will compare regions someday. In the actual lesson students do NOT compare or map any Texas regions; they only listen to unrelated music.
negative.expected_behavior: Never certify comprehensive TEKS compliance. If checked through the bounded Texas analysis, do not award SUPPORTED or PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED positive credit from merely aspirational goals or negated student actions. Explain any superficial matches and the narrow analysis scope.

review.commerce_description: This listing provides standards reference and bounded lesson analysis; it does not implement checkout or payment handling.

publication.release_notes: Updated teacher-facing national standards description and unrestricted eligible geography. Made the onboarding skill and reviewer scenarios future-ready: current state and lesson-analysis availability must come from live governed national tools rather than a fixed Texas/Virginia allowlist. Preserves the same MCP URL, five permanent tool contracts, original branding, and Free-versus-Paid boundaries.
